description: Creates a minimal Qt Widgets GUI application project with QMake, determines QTDIR, generates the Makefile, and runs a test build.
name: qt-qmake-create-gui-app-test-build
promptTemplate:
Create and execute the following shell script with the tool `skill_execute`, passing the complete script as the `content` parameter. The build system must be QMAKE and QTDIR must be detected before building. If the user does not provide `{{project_directory}}`, use the current working directory plus `QtGuiApp`.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_DIR="${PROJECT_DIR:-{{project_directory}}}"
if [ -z "$PROJECT_DIR" ] || [ "$PROJECT_DIR" = "{{project_directory}}" ]; then PROJECT_DIR="$PWD/QtGuiApp"; fi
APP_NAME="${APP_NAME:-QtGuiApp}"
find_qmake() {
  if [ -n "${QTDIR:-}" ] && [ -x "$QTDIR/bin/qmake" ]; then echo "$QTDIR/bin/qmake"; return 0; fi
  if command -v qmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v qmake; return 0; fi
  if command -v qmake6 >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v qmake6; return 0; fi
  for q in "$HOME"/Qt/*/macos/bin/qmake "$HOME"/Qt/*/clang_64/bin/qmake /Applications/Qt/*/macos/bin/qmake /opt/homebrew/opt/qt/bin/qmake /usr/local/opt/qt/bin/qmake; do
    [ -x "$q" ] && echo "$q" && return 0
  done
  return 1
}
QMAKE_BIN="$(find_qmake)" || { echo "qmake not found. Install Qt or set QTDIR." >&2; exit 1; }
export QTDIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$QMAKE_BIN")/.." && pwd)"
export PATH="$QTDIR/bin:$PATH"
mkdir -p "$PROJECT_DIR"
cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
cat > "$APP_NAME.pro" <<'PRO'
QT += widgets
CONFIG += c++17
TEMPLATE = app
TARGET = QtGuiApp
SOURCES += main.cpp
PRO
cat > main.cpp <<'CPP'
#include <QApplication>
#include <QLabel>
int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    QApplication app(argc, argv);
    QLabel label("Hello from Qt/QMake");
    label.resize(320, 120);
    label.show();
    return app.exec();
}
CPP
mkdir -p build
cd build
"$QMAKE_BIN" "../$APP_NAME.pro" CONFIG+=debug
make -j"$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4)"
```

Return the script output and clearly state the detected QTDIR.
